description: This file defines a console command class 'CertificateCommand' for managing and updating donor certificates within the Goteo project. It includes functions for configuring command-line options, executing actions such as updating donor data, calculating amounts, unifying certificates, and updating investments, by interfacing with the Donor and User models, as well as external libraries for console output.

classes.name: CertificateCommand
classes.description: A console command class to manage donor certificates: configure options, execute updates, unify certificates, and update investments, integrating donor and user models with console output.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configure the console command with its name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that processes command-line options to perform actions like updating donors, amounts, statuses, unifying certificates, or updating investments.

methods.name: update_invests
methods.description: Update or treat investments for certificates based on parameters, with progress reporting.

methods.name: unifyCertificates
methods.description: Unify multiple certificates for a user or all users for a given year into a single certificate.

methods.name: unifyUserCertificates
methods.description: Merge all certificates of a specific user for a given year into a new one, superseding old certificates.

methods.name: createNewCertificate
methods.description: Create a new donor certificate based on an existing one with aggregated data.

methods.name: supersedeOldCertificates
methods.description: Mark old certificates as superseded and delete their investments when a new certificate is created.

methods.name: writeToOutputWithProgressBar
methods.description: Assist bot output updates alongside progress bar updates.
